units.text: Cup with handle — complete daily method

Build this complete method as a strategy project. The attached numeric reference is reusable arithmetic, not a finished strategy. Adapt and test it; do not replace it with a template. The complete parameters and historical scope below are authoritative. Existing historical results or model answers are not inputs and no return target is required.

Code owns the numeric screen, cup/handle geometry, deterministic shortlist and cross-symbol entry priority. Use the reference's inclusive/exclusive boundaries and arithmetic exactly. Preserve the full 160-session candidate window and ten additional prior-advance sessions, so execution receives 170 calculation bars, 169 warmup bars; model and chart history is the last 160. All 40 selected instruments share the same cash account. Sort entry opportunities by breakout strength (close/prior-40-session high minus one), descending, then alphabetically. Use only dates at or before the decision close. Do not omit instruments, shorten the interval or use future returns to select candidates.

Candidate ranking: smallest relative rim-high difference, then longest cup duration, earliest right rim, earliest left rim. Merge overlapping alternatives only when bottom distance <=3 sessions and cup intersection/union >=0.75. Retain at most three candidates. Every candidate's geometry is fixed by the program. Preserve its original candidate ID, stop, target, volatility unit, left_rim/right_rim/bottom/handle_start/handle_end dates, numeric checks and shape facts. Encode the named dates under dates and remaining reference metrics under facts for the strategy-v1 entry candidate. The reference computes exact IDs; no model may invent or move anchors.

Use the optional risk-managed account policy exactly as configured below, not fixed-share sizing. At the signal close, the account determines integer shares from risk_fraction, max_weight and available cash using the allowed maximum entry price and commission. Pending entries reserve cash; held and pending positions count against max_positions. No position adding. Check account eligibility before requesting model judgment; when all candidates are ineligible, do not call a model. The account, not generated code or the model, owns balances, fills and position management. Emit ranked managed buy candidates with shares=0 and numeric priority. Avoid redundant holds for every symbol and do not duplicate account-generated exit orders.

Prior pending orders fill at the next session open, sells before buys; configured slippage applies adversely and commission is charged on both sides. Cancel an entry if its slipped open exceeds the maximum entry price, is at/below the fixed stop, or at/above the fixed target, without resizing. Signals and exits use the close; never use intraday fills. Close below the original stop triggers an exit, close at/above the fixed target triggers an exit. Progress resets its anchor and stagnant-session count when close advances by at least progress_units times the original volatility unit; otherwise increment the count. Exit on stagnation_sessions without that progress, not simply after a maximum holding age. trailing_stop_units=0 disables trailing. The account handles these configured exits and sells the entire position next open. Preserve end-of-window positions marked to market, no forced liquidation. Do not make new entry calls on the final session because no next open exists; final exits can remain unfilled.

Model assessment: after numeric and execution checks, assess every offered candidate separately for cup, handle and coherence. Cup means a decline, rounded bottom or sustained consolidation and recovery, not mainly a sharp V. Handle means a smaller shallow consolidation near the recovered upper rim. Coherence means one connected cup and handle, not unrelated segments. Numeric eligibility already passed: do not add hidden stricter numeric durations or depth limits. A steep drop/gap alone is not a failure if a sustained base follows. Rising breakout bars do not erase an earlier handle. Cite concise visible dated evidence; no forecasting. Cup evidence is inside left_rim..right_rim; handle evidence is inside handle_start..handle_end; coherence evidence is inside left_rim..handle_end. Exclude today's breakout from handle evidence. Include the attributed structural teaching distinctions below in the model criteria; they do not override approved numeric rules.

Declare named cup/handle/coherence rubrics with those exact anchor regions; all three must pass. Any fail makes the candidate fail; otherwise any insufficient_evidence makes it insufficient; otherwise pass. review_nonpass=true means one conditional review of EVERY non-pass candidate, even if another already passed. Review tests prior reasons/counterevidence, never votes or forces acceptance. Choose the earliest ranked candidate that finally passes and retain original geometry. If none passes, skip. Insufficient evidence skips rather than buying; transport errors, invalid responses or unavailable required tools stop visibly and retain receipts. repair_once=true permits one format correction of a received malformed response, never automatic retry of an unknown billing outcome.

Visual evidence is required: chart_and_text, declared history 160, fixed candidate markers, same-symbol cutoff OHLCV and candidate facts. Allowed shared read_bars/price_facts tools inspect only the provided interval, no web access or external images. This common interface supplies equivalent observable numeric evidence rather than importing a strategy-specific runner. The model cannot modify account rules, candidate geometry, numeric parameters or permissions. Execution uses the separately assigned model; its stochastic judgments need not match another historical run.

Please identify genuine contradictions or missing method choices; do not ask me to reconfirm parameters already explicitly supplied. Produce a complete draft with source references. Confirmed methods are immutable; repairs must preserve them and user changes require new versions. Tests must cover exact screening/geometry boundaries and ranking, no future access, warmup, managed candidate format and approved account configuration. A synthetic demo is a software test, not the historical run.

import json
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import strategy


def main():
    dates = []
    current = date(2025, 1, 2)
    while len(dates) < 170:
        if current.weekday() < 5:
            dates.append(current.isoformat())
        current += timedelta(days=1)
    bars = []
    for index, day in enumerate(dates):
        close = 70 + .23 * index
        high, low = close + 1, close - 1
        if 139 <= index <= 163:
            progress = abs(index - 151) / 12
            close = 100 + 12 * progress
            high, low = max(close + 1, 120 if index in (139, 163) else close + 1), close - 1
            if index == 151:
                low = 90
        if 164 <= index <= 168:
            close = 111 + (index - 164)
            high, low = 120, close - 1
        if index == 169:
            close, high, low = 122, 123, 121
        bars.append({"date": day, "open": close, "high": high, "low": low,
                     "close": close, "volume": 1000 if index < 169 else 2000})
    context = {"cutoff": dates[-1], "bars": {"SYNTH": bars},
               "account": {"cash": 100000, "available_cash": 100000,
                           "equity": 100000, "positions": {}},
               "state": {}, "previous_orders": []}
    decision = strategy.decide(context)
    transactions = []
    for proposal in decision["proposals"]:
        next_open = bars[-1]["open"] * (1 + strategy.PARAMS["entry_gap_limit"])
        transactions.append({
            "symbol": proposal["symbol"], "action": "managed_buy_candidate",
            "next_session_open": None, "allowed_max_entry_price": round(next_open, 4),
            "shares": 0, "candidate_ids": [item["candidate_id"] for item in proposal["candidates"]],
            "note": "Illustrative only; no model approval or account fill is simulated.",
        })
    output = {
        "label": "SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE EXAMPLE — not real market data or investment performance evidence",
        "inputs": {"symbol": "SYNTH", "bars": len(bars), "cutoff": context["cutoff"],
                   "price_path": "deterministic cup-like base, handle, and breakout"},
        "decision": decision, "simulated_transactions": transactions,
    }
    rendered = json.dumps(output, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    print(rendered)
    Path(__file__).with_name("result.json").write_text(rendered + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Cup with Handle · cup-v2

Implements the approved daily cup-with-handle method. The numeric screen, fixed geometry, deterministic candidate shortlist and priority are code-owned; per-candidate structure assessment is a required external model judgment. Approved source detail is documented by material ID `material-1` at L5-L17 and L24-L63, and numeric reference `material-2` at L11-L124.

## Runtime behavior

- Request 170 calculation bars (169 warmup); numerical pattern window and model/chart history use 160 bars. Inputs are cutoff-limited; the final scoped session creates no entry request.
- Candidates require a model pass for cup, handle and coherence. Insufficient evidence skips; infrastructure/model errors must stop visibly and retain request receipts. Conditional review applies to every non-pass candidate, once; a malformed response may be repaired once, but unknown transport outcomes are not retried.
- Candidate dates and geometry are code-fixed. Managed candidates use `sizing.shares=0`; the trusted account owns risk sizing, fills, cash, positions, and configured exits. Strategy state is passed through unchanged and never mutates account balances.
- Shared runner executes next-open fills, fees/slippage, limits, and managed stop/target/progress/stagnation exits. No explicit fixed-share sells or duplicate exits are generated here.
- This package does not access a model, market provider, network or credentials. Runtime depends on the approved controller for model capability/budget, chart rendering, trusted account policy and validated historical symbol data. The historical approved scope is 40 symbols over 718 sessions.

Run checks with `python -m unittest` and generate the deterministic synthetic example with `python demo.py`. The example is not market data or performance evidence.

"""Approved cup-v2 numeric screen and managed-entry proposal generation."""

import hashlib
import json


PARAMS = {
    "bottom_merge_sessions": 3, "breakout_buffer": 0.0, "breakout_lookback": 40,
    "candidate_overlap": .75, "cup_max": 120, "cup_min": 25, "depth_max": .50,
    "depth_min": .06, "entry_gap_limit": .01, "handle_max": 30,
    "handle_max_drop": .35, "handle_midpoint_fraction": .5, "handle_min": 5,
    "history_window": 160, "max_breakout_extension": .10, "max_candidates": 3,
    "prior_advance": .15, "prior_advance_lookback": 10, "priority_lookback": 120,
    "rim_tolerance": .08, "target_multiple": 5, "trend_buffer": -.03,
    "trend_period": 20, "trend_slope_min": .005, "trend_slope_sessions": 5,
    "volatility_period": 40, "volume_lookback": 10, "volume_multiple": 1.2,
}


def _required_history():
    p = PARAMS
    return max(p["history_window"] - 1, p["trend_period"] + p["trend_slope_sessions"] - 1,
               p["breakout_lookback"], p["volume_lookback"], p["volatility_period"],
               p["prior_advance_lookback"] + p["cup_min"] - 1)


def _atr(bars, i, period=40):
    return sum(max(bars[j]["high"] - bars[j]["low"],
                   abs(bars[j]["high"] - bars[j - 1]["close"]),
                   abs(bars[j]["low"] - bars[j - 1]["close"]))
               for j in range(i - period + 1, i + 1)) / period


def _screen(bars, i):
    p = PARAMS
    if i < _required_history():
        return False
    close = bars[i]["close"]
    sma = sum(x["close"] for x in bars[i-p["trend_period"]+1:i+1]) / p["trend_period"]
    old = sum(x["close"] for x in bars[i-p["trend_period"]-p["trend_slope_sessions"]+1:
                                      i-p["trend_slope_sessions"]+1]) / p["trend_period"]
    high = max(x["high"] for x in bars[i-p["breakout_lookback"]:i])
    average_volume = sum(x["volume"] for x in bars[i-p["volume_lookback"]:i]) / p["volume_lookback"]
    return (close > sma * (1 + p["trend_buffer"]) and
            sma > old * (1 + p["trend_slope_min"]) and
            close > high * (1 + p["breakout_buffer"]) and average_volume > 0 and
            bars[i]["volume"] >= p["volume_multiple"] * average_volume)


def _diagnose(bars, t, l, r, bottom, stop, pivot, target):
    p = PARAMS
    L, R, B = bars[l]["high"], bars[r]["high"], bars[bottom]["low"]
    handle = bars[r+1:t]
    checks = []
    def add(name, value, minimum=None, maximum=None, unit="ratio", strict=False):
        passed = ((minimum is None or (value > minimum if strict else value >= minimum)) and
                  (maximum is None or value <= maximum))
        checks.append({"name": name, "value": value, "minimum": minimum,
                       "maximum": maximum, "passed": passed, "unit": unit,
                       "strict_minimum": strict})
    add("cup_sessions", r-l+1, p["cup_min"], p["cup_max"], "sessions")
    add("handle_sessions", t-r-1, p["handle_min"], p["handle_max"], "sessions")
    add("bottom_internal", int(l < bottom < r), 1, 1, "boolean")
    add("rim_difference", abs(R-L)/L, 0, p["rim_tolerance"])
    add("cup_depth", (L-B)/L, p["depth_min"], p["depth_max"])
    add("prior_advance", L/bars[l-p["prior_advance_lookback"]]["close"]-1,
        p["prior_advance"])
    add("handle_above_midpoint", stop-(B+p["handle_midpoint_fraction"]*(L-B)), 0, None, "USD")
    add("handle_drop", (R-stop)/R, 0, p["handle_max_drop"])
    add("breakout_extension", bars[t]["close"]/pivot-1, p["breakout_buffer"],
        p["max_breakout_extension"], strict=True)
    add("target_headroom", target-bars[t]["close"], 0, None, "USD", strict=True)
    return checks


def _geometry(bars, t, left, right):
    p = PARAMS
    if not max(p["prior_advance_lookback"], t-p["history_window"]+1) <= left < right < t:
        return None
    bottom = min(range(left, right+1), key=lambda j: bars[j]["low"])
    if not left < bottom < right:
        return None
    cup_sessions, handle_sessions = right-left+1, t-right-1
    if not p["cup_min"] <= cup_sessions <= p["cup_max"] or not p["handle_min"] <= handle_sessions <= p["handle_max"]:
        return None
    L, R, B = bars[left]["high"], bars[right]["high"], bars[bottom]["low"]
    stop = min(x["low"] for x in bars[right+1:t])
    pivot = max(x["high"] for x in bars[right:t])
    close = bars[t]["close"]
    if (abs(R-L)/L > p["rim_tolerance"] or not p["depth_min"] <= (L-B)/L <= p["depth_max"] or
        L/bars[left-p["prior_advance_lookback"]]["close"]-1 < p["prior_advance"] or
        stop < B+p["handle_midpoint_fraction"]*(L-B) or
        not 0 <= (R-stop)/R <= p["handle_max_drop"] or
        not pivot*(1+p["breakout_buffer"]) < close <= (1+p["max_breakout_extension"])*pivot):
        return None
    target = pivot+p["target_multiple"]*(R-B)
    if not stop < close < target:
        return None
    volatility = _atr(bars, t, p["volatility_period"])
    if volatility <= 0:
        return None
    cup, handle = bars[left:right+1], bars[right+1:t]
    cup_volume = sum(x["volume"] for x in cup)/cup_sessions
    handle_volume = sum(x["volume"] for x in handle)/handle_sessions
    facts = {"numeric_checks": _diagnose(bars, t, left, right, bottom, stop, pivot, target),
             "left_high": L, "right_high": R, "bottom_low": B, "pivot": pivot,
             "bottom_band_price": B+.25*(L-B),
             "bottom_dwell_fraction": sum(x["low"] <= B+.25*(L-B) for x in cup)/cup_sessions,
             "handle_retrace_of_cup": (R-stop)/(R-B),
             "handle_volume_ratio": handle_volume/cup_volume if cup_volume else None}
    dates = {key: bars[index]["date"] for key, index in (
        ("left_rim", left), ("right_rim", right), ("bottom", bottom),
        ("handle_start", right+1), ("handle_end", t-1))}
    return {"candidate_id": "", "dates": dates, "stop": stop, "pivot": pivot,
            "target": target, "cup_depth": (L-B)/L, "cup_sessions": cup_sessions,
            "handle_sessions": handle_sessions, "volatility_unit": volatility,
            "visible_start": bars[max(0, t-p["history_window"]+1)]["date"],
            "left_high": L, "right_high": R, "bottom_low": B, "facts": facts,
            "_indices": (left, right, bottom), "rank": 0}


def _candidates(bars, symbol, i):
    p = PARAMS
    found = []
    for right in range(max(0, i-p["handle_max"]-1), i-p["handle_min"]):
        for left in range(max(p["prior_advance_lookback"], i-p["history_window"]+1,
                              right-p["cup_max"]+1), right-p["cup_min"]+2):
            candidate = _geometry(bars, i, left, right)
            if candidate:
                found.append(candidate)
    found.sort(key=lambda c: (
        abs(c["facts"]["right_high"]-c["facts"]["left_high"])/c["facts"]["left_high"],
        -c["cup_sessions"],
        c["dates"]["right_rim"], c["dates"]["left_rim"]))
    selected = []
    for candidate in found:
        left, right, bottom = candidate["_indices"]
        duplicate = False
        for prior in selected:
            prior_left, prior_right, prior_bottom = prior["_indices"]
            overlap = max(0, min(right, prior_right)-max(left, prior_left)+1) / (
                max(right, prior_right)-min(left, prior_left)+1)
            if abs(bottom-prior_bottom) <= p["bottom_merge_sessions"] and overlap >= p["candidate_overlap"]:
                duplicate = True
                break
        if duplicate:
            continue
        candidate["rank"] = len(selected)+1
        digest_payload = {
            "left_rim": candidate["dates"]["left_rim"],
            "right_rim": candidate["dates"]["right_rim"],
            "bottom": candidate["dates"]["bottom"], "stop": candidate["stop"],
            "pivot": candidate["pivot"], "target": candidate["target"],
            "cup_depth": candidate["cup_depth"], "cup_sessions": candidate["cup_sessions"],
            "handle_sessions": candidate["handle_sessions"],
            "volatility_unit": candidate["volatility_unit"],
            "visible_start": candidate["visible_start"],
            "handle_start": candidate["dates"]["handle_start"],
            "handle_end": candidate["dates"]["handle_end"],
            "left_high": candidate["facts"]["left_high"],
            "right_high": candidate["facts"]["right_high"],
            "bottom_low": candidate["facts"]["bottom_low"],
            "bottom_band_price": candidate["facts"]["bottom_band_price"],
            "bottom_dwell_fraction": candidate["facts"]["bottom_dwell_fraction"],
            "handle_retrace_of_cup": candidate["facts"]["handle_retrace_of_cup"],
            "handle_volume_ratio": candidate["facts"]["handle_volume_ratio"],
            "numeric_checks": candidate["facts"]["numeric_checks"],
        }
        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
            [symbol, bars[i]["date"], digest_payload], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        candidate["candidate_id"] = f'{symbol}-{bars[i]["date"]}-{digest}'
        selected.append(candidate)
        if len(selected) >= p["max_candidates"]:
            break
    for candidate in selected:
        del candidate["_indices"]
    return selected


def _account_eligible(context, symbol):
    account = context.get("account", {})
    positions = account.get("positions", {})
    pending = {order.get("symbol") for order in context.get("previous_orders", [])
               if order.get("action") == "buy" and order.get("status") in ("pending", "accepted")}
    occupied = {name for name, shares in positions.items() if shares} | pending
    return (symbol not in occupied and len(occupied) < 10 and
            account.get("available_cash", account.get("cash", 0)) > 0)


def decide(context):
    cutoff = context["cutoff"]
    proposals = []
    for symbol in sorted(context.get("bars", {})):
        bars = [dict(bar) for bar in context["bars"][symbol] if bar["date"] <= cutoff]
        if not bars or bars[-1]["date"] != cutoff or not _account_eligible(context, symbol):
            continue
        i = len(bars)-1
        if i < _required_history() or cutoff >= "2026-11-10" or not _screen(bars, i):
            continue
        candidates = _candidates(bars, symbol, i)
        if not candidates:
            continue
        priority = bars[i]["close"] / max(bar["high"] for bar in bars[i-40:i]) - 1
        projected = []
        for candidate in candidates:
            facts = dict(candidate["facts"])
            facts["rank"] = candidate["rank"]
            facts["cup_depth"] = candidate["cup_depth"]
            facts["cup_sessions"] = candidate["cup_sessions"]
            facts["handle_sessions"] = candidate["handle_sessions"]
            facts["visible_start"] = candidate["visible_start"]
            projected.append({
                "candidate_id": candidate["candidate_id"], "stop": candidate["stop"],
                "target": candidate["target"], "volatility_unit": candidate["volatility_unit"],
                "dates": candidate["dates"], "facts": facts,
            })
        proposals.append({
            "symbol": symbol, "action": "buy",
            "explanation": "cup-v2 numeric screen and fixed cup/handle geometry; managed sizing",
            "sizing": {"shares": 0},
            "judgment": "Assess every fixed candidate using the approved cup, handle, and coherence rubrics; cite dated visible evidence.",
            "priority": priority, "candidates": projected,
        })
    proposals.sort(key=lambda proposal: (-proposal["priority"], proposal["symbol"]))
    return {"proposals": proposals, "state": context.get("state", {})}

import unittest
import unittest.mock
from pathlib import Path

import strategy


def bars(count, close=100, high=None, low=None):
    return [{"date": f"2025-{1 + i // 28:02d}-{1 + i % 28:02d}",
             "open": close, "high": high if high is not None else close + 1,
             "low": low if low is not None else close - 1,
             "close": close, "volume": 100} for i in range(count)]


class StrategyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_warmup_and_cutoff_excludes_future(self):
        data = bars(170)
        self.assertFalse(strategy._screen(data, 168))
        context = {"cutoff": data[-2]["date"], "bars": {"ABC": data},
                   "account": {"cash": 1000, "positions": {}}}
        self.assertEqual(strategy.decide(context)["proposals"], [])

    def test_duration_bounds_inclusive_and_adjacent_excluded(self):
        data = bars(180, high=110, low=109)
        data[0]["close"] = 90
        for duration, expected in ((25, True), (24, False), (120, True), (121, False)):
            left, right, t = 10, 10 + duration - 1, 10 + duration + 5
            data[(left + right) // 2]["low"] = 99
            data[t] = dict(data[t], close=111, high=111, low=109)
            with unittest.mock.patch.object(strategy, "_atr", return_value=1):
                result = strategy._geometry(data, t, left, right)
            self.assertEqual(result is not None, expected, duration)

    def test_geometry_breakout_buffer_diagnostic_preserves_float_json_type(self):
        data = bars(170, close=100, high=101, low=99)
        left, right, signal = 20, 50, 56
        data[left]["high"] = data[right]["high"] = 110
        data[left - 10]["close"] = 90
        data[35]["low"] = 85
        for index in range(right + 1, signal):
            data[index]["low"] = 99
            data[index]["high"] = 110
        data[signal].update(close=111, high=112, low=109)

        candidate = strategy._geometry(data, signal, left, right)

        self.assertIsNotNone(candidate)
        breakout = next(check for check in candidate["facts"]["numeric_checks"]
                        if check["name"] == "breakout_extension")
        self.assertIs(type(breakout["minimum"]), float)
        self.assertIn('"minimum": 0.0', json.dumps(breakout))

    def test_selection_private_indices_deduplicates_and_exact_envelope(self):
        data = bars(200)
        original = strategy._geometry

        def fake(_bars, i, left, right):
            if (left, right) not in ((100, 150), (101, 151), (120, 160), (140, 170)):
                return None
            dates = {key: data[index]["date"] for key, index in (
                ("left_rim", left), ("right_rim", right), ("bottom", (left+right)//2),
                ("handle_start", right+1), ("handle_end", i-1))}
            return {"candidate_id": "", "dates": dates, "stop": 99., "pivot": 110.,
                    "target": 120., "cup_depth": .2, "cup_sessions": right-left+1,
                    "handle_sessions": i-right-1, "visible_start": data[i-159]["date"],
                    "volatility_unit": 2., "facts": {"left_high": 110., "right_high": 110.,
                    "bottom_low": 90., "bottom_band_price": 95.,
                    "bottom_dwell_fraction": .2, "handle_retrace_of_cup": .2,
                    "handle_volume_ratio": .8,
                    "numeric_checks": {"cup_sessions": right-left+1},
                    "breakout_strength": .03}, "_indices": (left, right, (left+right)//2), "rank": 0}

        with unittest.mock.patch.object(strategy, "_geometry", side_effect=fake):
            chosen = strategy._candidates(data, "ABC", 180)
        self.assertEqual(len(chosen), 3)
        self.assertTrue(all("_indices" not in item for item in chosen))
        self.assertTrue(all(item["candidate_id"].startswith("ABC-") for item in chosen))
        context = {"cutoff": "2025-01-01", "bars": {}, "account": {"cash": 10, "positions": {}}}
        self.assertEqual(strategy.decide(context)["proposals"], [])

    def test_candidate_id_hashes_full_original_candidate_before_projection(self):
        data = bars(200)
        fake = {"candidate_id": "", "dates": {"left_rim": data[20]["date"],
                "right_rim": data[50]["date"], "bottom": data[35]["date"],
                "handle_start": data[51]["date"], "handle_end": data[179]["date"]},
                "stop": 99., "pivot": 110., "target": 120., "cup_depth": .2,
                "cup_sessions": 31, "handle_sessions": 129, "visible_start": data[21]["date"],
                "volatility_unit": 2.,
                "facts": {"left_high": 110., "right_high": 110., "bottom_low": 90.,
                          "bottom_band_price": 95., "bottom_dwell_fraction": .2,
                          "handle_retrace_of_cup": .2, "handle_volume_ratio": .8,
                          "numeric_checks": {"cup_sessions": 31}, "breakout_strength": .03},
                "_indices": (20, 50, 35), "rank": 0}
        with unittest.mock.patch.object(strategy, "_geometry", return_value=fake.copy()):
            result = strategy._candidates(data, "ABC", 180)[0]
        payload = {
            "left_rim": result["dates"]["left_rim"], "right_rim": result["dates"]["right_rim"],
            "bottom": result["dates"]["bottom"], "stop": result["stop"], "pivot": result["pivot"],
            "target": result["target"], "cup_depth": result["cup_depth"],
            "cup_sessions": result["cup_sessions"], "handle_sessions": result["handle_sessions"],
            "volatility_unit": result["volatility_unit"], "visible_start": result["visible_start"],
            "handle_start": result["dates"]["handle_start"], "handle_end": result["dates"]["handle_end"],
            "left_high": result["facts"]["left_high"], "right_high": result["facts"]["right_high"],
            "bottom_low": result["facts"]["bottom_low"],
            "bottom_band_price": result["facts"]["bottom_band_price"],
            "bottom_dwell_fraction": result["facts"]["bottom_dwell_fraction"],
            "handle_retrace_of_cup": result["facts"]["handle_retrace_of_cup"],
            "handle_volume_ratio": result["facts"]["handle_volume_ratio"],
            "numeric_checks": result["facts"]["numeric_checks"],
        }
        expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
            ["ABC", data[180]["date"], payload], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        self.assertEqual(result["candidate_id"], f"ABC-{data[180]['date']}-{expected}")

    def test_account_policy_priority_and_schema(self):
        manifest = json.loads(Path("execution.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(manifest["warmup_bars"], 169)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["history_bars"], 170)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["account"]["max_positions"], 10)
        self.assertEqual(set(manifest["judgment"]["rubric"]), {"cup", "handle", "coherence"})
        self.assertTrue(strategy._account_eligible(
            {"account": {"cash": 100, "available_cash": 50, "positions": {}}}, "ABC"))
        self.assertFalse(strategy._account_eligible(
            {"account": {"cash": 100, "available_cash": 0, "positions": {}}}, "ABC"))
        self.assertFalse(strategy._account_eligible(
            {"account": {"cash": 100, "positions": {"ABC": 1}}}, "ABC"))

    def test_proposal_projection_has_contract_fields_and_code_priority(self):
        data = bars(170)
        data[-1]["close"] = 110
        data[-1]["high"] = 111
        candidate = {"candidate_id": "ABC-id", "dates": {"left_rim": data[20]["date"],
            "right_rim": data[50]["date"], "bottom": data[35]["date"],
            "handle_start": data[51]["date"], "handle_end": data[168]["date"]},
            "stop": 99., "target": 120., "volatility_unit": 2., "cup_depth": .2,
            "cup_sessions": 31, "handle_sessions": 118, "visible_start": data[10]["date"],
            "rank": 1, "facts": {"numeric_checks": [], "breakout_strength": .99}}
        context = {"cutoff": data[-1]["date"], "bars": {"ABC": data},
                   "account": {"cash": 10000, "available_cash": 10000, "positions": {}}}
        with unittest.mock.patch.object(strategy, "_screen", return_value=True), \
             unittest.mock.patch.object(strategy, "_candidates", return_value=[candidate]):
            proposal = strategy.decide(context)["proposals"][0]
        self.assertEqual(set(proposal["candidates"][0]),
                         {"candidate_id", "stop", "target", "volatility_unit", "dates", "facts"})
        self.assertNotIn("rank", proposal["candidates"][0])
        self.assertEqual(proposal["priority"], 110 / max(x["high"] for x in data[-41:-1]) - 1)
        self.assertEqual(proposal["sizing"], {"shares": 0})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
